speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will need to rely on your parents to describe any symptoms you have noticed. To begin, how long has your baby been experiencing symptoms, and have there been any fever, lethargy, or feeding difficulties?

text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: I need to see the physical exam findings and vital signs to proceed.
